title: Owner-Authorized Private Audio Metadata Read

businessSequence.currentConstraint: The creator loop can create and manage projects but cannot yet inspect canonical audio assets belonging to those projects.
businessSequence.capabilityUnlocked: A signed-in project owner can privately enumerate and inspect sanitized audio metadata through server-authorized product boundaries.

authorization: Every audio metadata read first proves authenticated ownership of the canonical project.
Audio asset ownership is derived through the canonical project relationship.
A caller cannot gain access merely by knowing an AudioAssetId.
An audio asset whose persisted projectId contradicts the authorized route project fails closed.
Principal authentication alone does not grant Sesh project or audio authority.
privatePresentation: Responses expose only product-facing audio metadata.
projectId is route context and is not repeated in the sanitized audio representation.
ownerCreatorId and PrincipalId are never returned.
hasStoredAudio may disclose only whether canonical metadata references stored binary audio to the already-authorized owner.
persistence: Reuse existing canonical project authorization through AuthorizedSeshProjectOperationService.readProject.
Do not conflate audio metadata lifecycle with binary-object lifecycle.
http: All JSON responses are cache-control no-store.
No public availability oracle is created.
No same-origin write logic is necessary because this slice has no mutation method.
rightsBoundary: Audio metadata does not prove copyright ownership.
Audio metadata does not prove master ownership.
Audio metadata does not grant publishing rights.
Audio metadata does not grant distribution rights.
Audio metadata does not grant management rights.
Audio metadata does not grant licensing rights.
Audio metadata does not grant royalty or revenue rights.

nextSlice.designRequirement: Design explicit compensation and project-graph attachment rules across private R2 binary persistence, D1 metadata persistence, and project revision-safe attachment before granting upload authority.
